definitions.gloss: age at death; one's age when one died
definitions.explanation: The age a person had reached when they died, as given in obituaries, death notices, funeral announcements and on gravestones. It is placed directly before the number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{享年|きょうねん}{九十二|きゅうじゅうに}だった。
examples.english: My grandfather was ninety-two when he died.

examples.japanese: ⟦{墓石|ぼせき}→墓石：27326_boseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{享年|きょうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれている→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: The name and age at death are carved on the gravestone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訃報|ふほう}→訃報：31269_fuhou⟧⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{享年|きょうねん}{七十八|ななじゅうはち}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}かれていた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The obituary column in the newspaper said he died at seventy-eight.

notes:
A formal word, used only of someone who has died. It literally means the years one received from heaven.

USAGE:
- {享年|きょうねん} + number: the traditional style leaves out ⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧ ({享年|きょうねん}{八十|はちじゅう}); {享年|きょうねん}{八十歳|はちじゅっさい} is also common today
- Traditionally the age was counted in ⟦{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}→数え年：22294_kazoedoshi⟧ (counting the year of birth as one), so it can be a year higher than the age in ordinary years (⟦{満|まん}{年齢|ねんれい}→満年齢：23904_mannenrei⟧); many families now use the ordinary age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行年|ぎょうねん}: age at death — a synonym found mainly in Buddhist contexts and on grave markers
- {没年|ぼつねん}: the year of death, or sometimes the age at death
